newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound rises against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound rises against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound rose against the dollar on Monday in a market still slightly short of the U.S. currency, bankers said.
"The market is a little short of dollars. But there is still supply and demand," one banker said.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3915 and 3.3965 pounds bid and 3.3935 and 3.3975 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average exchange rate was 3.3935 bid and 3.395375 offered compared to 3.394125 bid and 3.3960 offered on Sunday.
The Central Bank calculated the average rate at midday as 3.389916 pounds buy and 3.395312 pounds sell.
